description: What the cleaner window may ask of the app: to scan, to hunt for large files, to list the user's apps, or on Windows the installed programs and start the uninstaller of one the user confirmed or open Windows Settings at the installed apps, to map the home folder and on a Mac open System Settings at Full Disk Access, to remove, look at again or show in Finder what it listed or mapped, to stop, to stop the dev daemons that keep a listed item in use, to read the disk's size, to be told the settings as they change, and to be dragged by its top.
